## Objective

- Create a GitHub account
- Get access to the Intro to Git/GitHub materials
- Install Git Client - GitHub Desktop

## GitHub Account and Access


1. If you do not already have a GitHub account, follow [these best-practice instructions](https://github.com/worldbank/dime-github-trainings/blob/master/GitHub-resources/DIME-GitHub-Guides/Creating-GitHub-account.md) to sign up. If you already have a GitHub account, you do **not** need to create a separate one for your WB work.
2. Share username with Impact Analytics team
3. Accept the invitation to the training repository

## GitHub Desktop

1. Install the GitHub Desktop application. This is a free GitHub client approved for WB computers and the client used in this training because it is beginner-friendly.
	- **Personal computer**: [Download GitHub Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/).
	- **WB computer**: Open *Software Center* from the Windows Start menu, search for **GitHub Desktop**, and click **Install**.
2. After installing GitHub Desktop, open it and go to *File* → *Options*, then log in using your GitHub account.
3. *Optional but recommended*: Go to *Help* → *About GitHub Desktop* to check for updates. GitHub Desktop will update itself automatically when a newer version is available.
